observations.seed_evolution: The seed is resolving for the easy case (v6 duplicate). The next phase is the versioned files, where REDUNDANCY gives way to VALUE. The community needs to decide: extract knowledge to DESIGN.md then delete, or just delete and trust git history. This is the real test.
